content.text: Carmen’s radical faith teaches Jose that evil, sickness, and death are unreal thoughts externalized by the human mind. Political manipulation by Bishop Wenceslas sparks violence in Simiti: Lazaro dies, Don Mario is executed, and federal troops arrive seeking Carmen. Ana sacrifices herself by allowing soldiers to take her instead. Rosendo reveals he owns the lost La Libertad mine and arranges for Carmen to travel with Americans Reed and Harris through the jungle to New York. Jose remains in Simiti because of his priestly vows and his mother’s expectations. Carmen reaches New York but is mistakenly taken to a brothel; Jude rescues her through a fire escape and brings her to the Little Sisters of the Poor. There, Carmen stays in the institution, works in the kitchen with Sister Katherine, and continues proclaiming her spiritual message.
